arabic text: YE MAA KI LAASH PE BOLE HUSSAIN RO RO KAR\nBICHAR KE TUM SE NA JEE PAAEGA TUMHARA PISAR
english translation text: Weeping over his mother's body, Hussain said:\nafter separation from you, your son will not be able to live.

arabic text: TUMHAARE LAAL KO PAALEGA KAUN AY AMMA(n)\nQADAM QADAM PE SAMBHALEGA KAUN AY AMMA(n)\nTUMHAARE LAAL NE KHAAYI AGAR KAHEE(n) THOKAR
english translation text: Who will raise your beloved son, Mother?\nWho will steady him at every step, Mother,\nshould your son ever stumble?

arabic text: NABI KA PURSA DIYA THA SATA KE AY AMMA(n)\nKE PHIR SE GHAR NA JALAA DE WOH AA KE AY AMMA(n)\nTUMHARA PURSA HUMEI(n) DENE LOG AAYE AGAR
english translation text: They tormented you even when offering condolences for the Prophet, Mother.\nMay they not return to burn our home again, Mother,\nif people come to offer us condolences for you.

arabic text: TUMHAARI TARHA AY AMMA(n) CHUPA GAYE BABA\nNISHAA(n) HAI UNKI BHI GARDAN PE EK RASSI KA\nGALE LAGAATE NAHI(n) IS LIYE HUME HAIDER
english translation text: Like you, Mother, Baba concealed his grief.\nThere is also a rope-mark upon his neck.\nPerhaps this is why Haider does not embrace us.

arabic text: YE AISE ROTE HAI(n) KE MAA KI ROOH TARAPTI HAI\nHASSAN KE PAAO(n) SE JAISE, ZAMEE(n) NIKALTI HAI\nGIRA HAI AASMA(n) JAISE HUSSAIN KE UPAR
english translation text: He weeps so intensely that a mother's soul would tremble.\nIt is as though the ground slips beneath Hasan's feet,\nand the heavens have fallen upon Hussain.

arabic text: YOO(n) LAG RAHA HAI KE AWAAZ MAA NE DI HAI ABHI\nYE MAR NA JAAE KAHI(n) KARBALA SE PEHLE HI\nDILAASA DO ZARA BHAAYI KO ZAINAB e MUZTAR
english translation text: It feels as though Mother has just called out.\nMay he not die before reaching Karbala.\nO grieving Zainab, console your brother.

arabic text: HUSSAIN DEKHNE AMMA(n) KA MOONH NA AATE THE\nYE KEHKE ROTE THE SHABBIR GHASH BHI KHAATE THE\nQAREEB AAWUNGA AMMA(n) MUJHE BULAAE(n) AGAR
english translation text: Hussain could not bring himself to look upon Mother's face.\nShabbir wept and fainted repeatedly, saying:\nI will come close, Mother, when you call me.

arabic text: YE SUN KE BAND e KAFAN FATIMA KE TOOT GAYE\nBULAYA ZAHRA NA BETE KO HAATH PHAILA KE\nTUMHARE WAASTE JANNAT SE AAGAYI MADAR
english translation text: Hearing this, the knots of Fatima's shroud opened.\nZahra stretched out her hands and called her son:\nI have come from Paradise for you.

arabic text: KARIM ROTE HAI(n) SHABBIR, MAA KE LAG KE GALE\nAB IS SE AAGE HASSAN KAZMI BHI KYA LIKHE\nALI KE GHAR ME QAYAMAT SE KAM NAHI(n) MANZAR
english translation text: O Karim, Shabbir weeps clinging to his mother.\nWhat more can Hasan Kazmi write?\nThe scene within Ali's home was no less than Judgement Day.
